title: DB Governance Runtime Bootstrap
purpose: Begin converting the live DB from a retrieval projection layer into an active governance application gate.

basis.finding: DB is real and partially state-aware, but not DB-first and not a complete knowledge-state layer.

core_rule.statement: Governed agents must query the DB governance runtime before applying patches, changing authority-bearing files, or resolving blocked dependencies.
core_rule.effect: DB becomes the operational gate for application decisions; docs remain long-form narrative authority.

new_required_surfaces.name: governance_runtime_decision_view
new_required_surfaces.purpose: Return apply/block/defer decisions for proposed agent actions.

new_required_surfaces.name: patch_application_gate_view
new_required_surfaces.purpose: Check patch dependencies, missing provenance, authority conflicts, and required validators.

new_required_surfaces.name: authority_resolution_view
new_required_surfaces.purpose: Resolve which authority wins when files, registries, or claims conflict.

new_required_surfaces.name: current_state_view
new_required_surfaces.purpose: Expose current RT, active authority, open debt, and live blockers.

new_required_surfaces.name: governance_decision_log
new_required_surfaces.purpose: Record every DB governance decision and its evidence basis.

required_repo_changes: Add DB-first governance runtime rule to agent instructions.
Add schema stub or migration for governance decision logging.
Add scaffold query command for patch gate decisions.
Mark existing document-first routing as fallback only.
Register debt for incomplete runtime views.
non_goals: Do not replace docs or textbook as narrative authority.
Do not require full semantic DB completion in this patch.
Do not rewrite the full retrieval system yet.
success_criteria: A proposed patch can be classified by DB gate as apply/block/defer.
A blocked patch returns a structured reason.
Agents are instructed not to apply governed changes without this check.
